quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026), record net sales and profit: net sales JPY 240,574 million (up 16.3%), operating profit JPY 24,572 million (up 28.8%), ordinary profit JPY 26,488 million (up 41.2%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 19,782 million (up 32.5%). Gross margin rose 1.8 points to 21.0% and operating margin 1.0 point to 10.2%. Management states demand kept expanding in data-center fields led by AI servers; automotive boards grew on sales to new customers, smartphone / tablet boards on high-end models, information and communication boards rose sharply on satellite communications, module boards were strong in SSDs and communication modules, and the electronics (EMS) business held firm on contract development; profit was helped by a large increase in high-value build-up boards, higher factory utilisation and productivity gains despite higher resource prices.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 240,574 million (+16.3%); operating profit JPY 24,572 million (+28.8%); gross margin 21.0%; operating margin 10.2%

quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company target: net sales growth at a compound annual rate of 24% and operating profit growth of 38% through the company's fiscal 2028 (its year beginning April 2028). Management states automotive boards will see only moderate growth, against rising demand for smartphone, satellite-communication and AI-server boards; package substrates are delayed against the original plan by the deteriorating semiconductor market, and the company aims to make that plant profitable as the market recovers; in the electronics business it made an acquisition to strengthen contract development and will accelerate a global one-stop service.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales CAGR 24% and operating profit growth 38% through the company's fiscal 2028 (year beginning April 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: On rising demand for smartphone, satellite-communication and AI-server boards, the company has started mass production at its fourth Vietnam plant; the Hoa Binh plant starts mass production from the company's fiscal 2026 (its year beginning April 2026); with demand expected to keep expanding, it is investing in construction of the Hoa Binh second plant, the Quang Minh third plant and the Yen Quang plant.

quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D expenses JPY 8,418 million. Themes: high-precision build-up boards for next-generation automotive needs such as autonomous driving; high-frequency and millimetre-wave radar boards for 5G equipment; metal-base, copper-inlay, mega-through-hole and thick-copper boards for high-voltage / high-current electrification; component-embedded, flexible and M-VIA Flex boards; for AI, high-layer-count boards for high-speed transmission, and as AI power products an IC-embedded power substrate and passive-component-embedded power modules. Joint development with university research institutions started in the company's fiscal 2025 (its year beginning April 2025).

quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: In new-field module and package products the company is developing ultra-thin coreless structures, CSP substrates made with MSAP and SAP processes and FCBGA substrates targeting logic and memory, and is also developing structures using glass and ceramic core materials.
